title: Auto-enroll Resy NotifyMe when a sniped booking fails
description:
Today a snipe that fails its booking race (slot taken before our /3/book lands, anti-bot
challenge, etc.) goes terminal — Failed, no follow-up. The user has to re-snipe manually
or wait for a future drop.

User intent (from conversation, 2026-05-17):
  "If we try sniping a time and it is not secured, we want to set a Notify alert so we will
   continue to monitor the slot."

Scope:
  - Reverse-engineer Resy's NotifyMe enrollment POST endpoint via mobile-app packet capture
    (Charles/mitmproxy) — likely POST /3/notify or /2/user/notify but unconfirmed
  - Add Provider.EnrollNotifyMe(ctx, sess, venue, date, partySize, times) error to providers
  - Implement in internal/resy/; route through doSignedAndRetry like Find/Book
  - Engine path: on a NON-NotifyMe snipe transitioning to Failed (specifically a booking-race
    loss, not a hard provider error), optionally call EnrollNotifyMe and re-submit the
    intent with NotifyMeRelease so the watch loop picks up future alerts
  - Opt-in per quest: new field in watch.toml (auto_enroll_on_fail = true) and matching
    flag on the single-snipe CLI
  - Sentinel: providers.ErrNotifyMeEnrollmentTaken (already enrolled) treated as success

Out of scope:
  - Un-enrolling (Resy DELETE on the enrollment) — separate follow-up if we want to clean
    up after a successful book

Risks:
  - Resy ToS — programmatic enrollment is more visible than reading alert emails.
  - If we auto-enroll on every failed snipe, we could accumulate stale enrollments
    server-side; mitigate by setting an explicit ttl/cleanup or only enrolling once per
    (user, venue, date)
acceptance_criteria: Provider.EnrollNotifyMe is wired; auto_enroll_on_fail flag on watch entries triggers re-submission as NotifyMeRelease on a booking-race loss; manual end-to-end verification against a real Resy account succeeds

title: Pre-existing reservation check: skip booking when user already has matching reservation
description:
The dedup tracker shipped in 4d32574 only catches in-process duplicates within one watch run.
If a user manually booked a venue+date outside the watch process, our snipe will still attempt
to book again when an alert fires — producing a double-booking that the engine has no way to
detect today.

User intent (from conversation, 2026-05-17):
  "If we have duplicates at the same time or already have a reservations then we will keep
   the current reservation."

Scope:
  - Add Provider.ListMyReservations(ctx, sess) ([]Reservation, error) to internal/providers
  - Implement in internal/resy/ against the appropriate user-reservations endpoint
    (likely GET /3/user/reservations — confirm via Resy app capture; same approach as the
    NotifyMe enrollment work)
  - Engine pre-Book gate in driveOneWatch (cmd/resy-snipe/watch.go): on Awaiting transition,
    fetch reservations; if one matches (venue, date), transition to Canceled with reason
    "existing_reservation" rather than running the booking race
  - Cache reservations per process; refresh on each Awaiting (account endpoint, low anti-bot
    weight, cheap)
  - Tests: golden fixture from a captured /3/user/reservations response, plus an engine test
    that proves the pre-Book gate triggers

Out of scope:
  - Cross-process dedup (one watch process trumps another — needs persistent state)
  - Detecting reservations made on Resy partner apps (OpenTable, Tock); only Resy-side
acceptance_criteria: Provider interface has ListMyReservations; resy adapter implementation passes a golden test against captured response; driveOneWatch checks existing reservations pre-Book and cancels with reason=existing_reservation; integration test covers the cancel path

title: Native phone+SMS login flow for Resy accounts without settable passwords
description:
Today phone-based Resy accounts (no settable password) use
'resy-snipe login -token-env RESY_AUTH_TOKEN' to import a JWT captured
from the mobile app or browser. That works but requires the user to
do the capture, and re-do it whenever the JWT expires (~4-6 weeks).

A first-class flow would:
  1. resy-snipe login -phone +1XXXXXXXXXX
     - POSTs to Resy's SMS-init endpoint (TBD — needs Resy app
       capture; candidate paths /3/auth/sms or /3/auth/password)
     - Resy texts the user a 6-digit code
  2. Prompt for the code, POST to verify endpoint
  3. Receive JWT, seal via existing UpsertSession path

Scope:
  - Reverse-engineer Resy's phone-auth endpoints (mobile-app capture
    via mitmproxy / Charles Proxy)
  - Two-step CLI flow with the interactive code prompt
  - Same sealed-session output as Login + ImportSession (so the rest
    of the system is unchanged)
  - MFA-like UX in the existing CompleteMFA seam if it generalizes
  - Test fixtures derived from a real capture

ToS / risk:
  - Programmatic SMS auth is more visible to Resy than email reading;
    same class of risk as auto-enroll NotifyMe (resy-snipe-bz9)
  - Mitigate by aggressive throttling — never re-init SMS more than
    once per N minutes

Workaround until shipped:
  - resy-snipe login -token-env (in tree as of c30aefc) covers the
    case at the cost of manual token refresh
acceptance_criteria: Phone-based users can run 'resy-snipe login -phone <number>' and complete authentication without leaving the CLI; sealed session is indistinguishable from one created by email+password Login; re-running with the same number refreshes the token cleanly

title: Wire RESY_SNIPE_SIGNER_BIN automatically in notify-launch.sh and warn when unset
description:
scripts/notify-launch.sh runs resy-snipe watch with RESY_SNIPE_SIGNER_BIN unset by default,
so the resy adapter falls back to internal/resy/sign.Noop. That's fine at low volume but
Resy may serve anti-bot challenges on Find/Book at higher cadences or during venue drops.
The printing-press signer already exists (internal/resy/sign/, see signers/obscura-resy.sh
and docs/signers.md from R7) — it just isn't wired into the script.

Scope:
  - notify-launch.sh: detect a signer binary at signers/obscura-resy.sh (or operator
    override via $RESY_SNIPE_SIGNER_BIN). Warn at launch when unset; export when present.
  - docs/notify-me.md: add a short "signer for production runs" section linking to
    docs/signers.md and the getting-started signer setup
  - docs/signers.md: extend with a watch-mode example (the current doc is single-snipe
    focused)
  - Optionally: ship a default binary path the script picks up automatically when the
    signer binary lives at $REPO_ROOT/signers/

Out of scope:
  - Building the signer subprocess itself (already done in R7)
acceptance_criteria: notify-launch.sh warns loudly when no signer is configured and auto-detects signers/obscura-resy.sh when present; docs/notify-me.md has a 'signer for production' section
